title: Birthday celebration
description: Make your birthday unforgettable with a private screening, custom decorations, and a premium theatre experience. celebrate with friends and family on a 150-inch screen with dolby atmos sound.

title: Proposal night
description: Propose in the most romantic way possible—under the stars on a giant screen with your favourite movie and personalized touches to make the moment magical.

title: Romantic date
description: Surprise your special someone with a private movie date. enjoy a cozy atmosphere with plush seating, gourmet snacks, and your favourite romantic films.

title: Bride-to-be celebration
description: Host a memorable bridal shower or bachelorette party with a private screening. custom themes, decorations, and entertainment await you and your closest friends.

title: Anniversary celebration
description: Celebrate your love with a private movie night designed just for you. enjoy a tailored experience with your favourite film, snacks, and intimate ambiance.

title: Family & friends gathering
description: Gather your loved ones for a movie night in our private theatre. watch the latest releases or your old favourites on a giant screen with surround sound for the perfect bonding experience.
